Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fitchburg for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from the Oregon Tree Lighting at Triangle Park (December 4) through the Fitchburg Holiday Lights Tour and Jubilee (December 11 to 13, with a family kickoff at the Agora on Friday, December 11, 5 to 8 pm) to Santa at Fire Station 1 (December 12, 6 to 8 pm). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fitchburg

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Fitchburg
  • 2 free events: the Holiday Lights Tour and Jubilee (some activities priced separately) and Santa at Fire Station 1
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Fire Station 1 (December 12, 6 to 8 pm) and the Oregon Tree Lighting (December 4, Santa visits at 6 pm)
  • Lights: the Oregon Tree Lighting (December 4) and the Fitchburg Holiday Lights Tour (December 11 to 13) with the Jubilee kickoff at the Agora
  • Season: December 4 to 13
